endorsements.name: Berat Arslan
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-0546
endorsements.description:
Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation (XSS or 'Cross-site Scripting'), Improper Restriction of Rendered UI Layers or Frames vulnerability in Mevzuattr Software MevzuatTR allows Phishing, iFrame Overlay, Clickjacking, Forceful Browsing. This issue needs high privileges. 

This issue affects MevzuatTR: before 12.02.2025.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 4.7)
